rationale: Accept the exact extension catalog after independently checking the actual proposal, native audit, initial candidate bindings and installed predecessor. The candidate archive contains 68 core definitions and 49 reviewed items, while the builder’s accepted-addition map has 27 affected keys: the proposal correctly contains those 27 boards and 49 retained additions, with no competing-output diagnostics. All 49 candidate payloads remain hash-bound to the own-role initial review; every addition also matches its predecessor exactly. Core recipes, routes, seeds, targets, categories, optimal par and edge snapshots are unchanged for all 27 entries. The only node changes are seven standard grammatical forms for Cortină, Chitară and the musical-instrument Vioară, supported again by retained exact-head normative evidence; only their three entry hashes change accordingly. No plant/adjective sense, held owner family, new concept or altered recipe meaning is introduced. The unchanged visible pair/result associations and edge captions remain readable in their existing school, cultural and everyday contexts. Each addition stays within the original concept/cohort scope, uses an absent pair with one output and two strong non-distractor graph links, and cannot use the target as an input or return a seed. The actual native audit reports 27 reconstructed boards and 49 additions with core/routes/par and graph-provenance preservation true. Independent static breadth-first checks also find exactly the preserved optimal par before and after additions for every affected board. Proposal, audit, candidate, fixed quality identity, source15, committed quick/world and current KG/pack/rubric bindings agree with the bounded provenance checks. No missing, duplicated or failed affected entry was found. This does not count 68 output boards, rerun native audits, assert HTTP gameplay or prove enjoyment; root must complete fresh ConfirmFinal and every remaining write, corpus, authority, test-pin and AFTER gate.
